It produces human-like voices and supports speech output in multiple languages and dialects. Use cases include content moderation, text creation, visual recognition, and audio-video interaction. Supported regions: Singapore, Beijing. Use the API key for your region. Getting started Prerequisites Obtain an API key and set the API key as an environment variable .
